about_the_game:
A mystical detective story with bloody games.

Features

♣ The atmosphere of the 30s in a modern setting

♢ Many choices and a few ways to pass

♥ Unique gamble with game bosses

♤ Be tricky or use your mind

♦ A universe with magical contracts and destiny

♧ Develop relationships with other players or dig deep for the truth

Story

In a world where evil secretly rules and fate holds the most power, two heroes accidentally find their way into the mysterious "Hell Well" casino. Inside, they are met by bosses who want to play tricky mind games. Well, and we have... and we have a huge bonus for luck! In addition to the boss gamble the main event of the evening is a deadly auction of mystical items. All the bigwigs of the underworld are coming tonight, and we're going to beat them all!

1/5 ACTS

8000+ words, 21 cg, 3 ends

📍Warning: Screamers, black humor, guro, drugs
